description: Page-change documents at the server's size limits, built with characters that take more than one byte or more than one UTF-16 unit. Each side builds a case from its description (backend/tests/unit/schemas/test_visual_limit_cases.py for the server, validate.test.ts for the script) and must reach `accepted`. `build` is text (one set_text whose text is `count` copies of `unit`), changes (`count` hide changes) or bytes (set_text changes whose compact UTF-8 JSON is exactly `count` bytes; see either test for the recipe).
